song.title: I know my Redeemer lives
song.lyrics:
[V1] Who told the sun where to stand in the morning? Who told the ocean you can only come this far? Who showed the moon where to hide 'til evening? Whose words alone can catch a falling star?
[C1] . G C G/C D I know my Redeemer lives . C B7 C I know my Redeemer lives . C D All of creation testify . B7 B7/D# Em This life within me cries . D C D G I know my Redeemer lives
[V2] The very same God that spins things in orbit Runs to the weary, the worn and the weak And the same gentle hands that hold me when I'm broken They conquered death to bring me victory
[B1] He lives to take away my sin And He lives forever I proclaim That the payment for my sin was the precious life He gave But now He's alive and there's an empty grave
